items.title: Fleetwood Town vs Arsenal: The Cod Army Dare to Dream of a Carabao Cup
items.excerpt: A David vs Goliath clash is underway as Fleetwood Town, the minnows, prepare to challenge one of English football's biggest clubs, Arsenal, in the third round of the EFL
body: Fleetwood Town have not been at their best in the 2026-27 League Two campaign with just three wins from 13 games. The Lancashire-based outfit have no choice but to turn their attention to the EFL Cup to restore their confidence.

The Cod Army are competing in the third round of this competition for the first time in club history. It has been a terrific run, with the team securing wins over fellow League Two opponents Chesterfield and Shrewsbury Town before upsetting Championship side Sheffield United in the second round with a 1-0 home victory.

Fleetwood Town's success in the EFL Cup has been built on their organised defense that has kept three clean sheets. Keeping another clean sheet would allow them to match Tranmere Rovers' achievement from the 1988-89 campaign, a record that has stood among fourth-tier teams ever since.

Head coach Matt Lawlor and company now have their eyes on a bigger prize: slaying the giant. Arsenal present a tough challenge but the minnows will be determined to rewrite the script and make this a night to remember.

items.title: “A Dream Come True” - England Captain Harry Kane Wins 2026 Ballon d’Or
items.excerpt: England’s captain Harry Kane was announced as the 2026 Ballon d’Or winner last night in London. The Bayern Munich striker edged Real Madrid’s Kylian Mbappe and Barcelona’
body: Harry Kane has won the 2026 Ballon d’Or, becoming the first Englishman to receive football’s most prestigious individual honour since Michael Owen in 2001.

The 33-year-old Bayern Munich and England captain was presented with the coveted golden ball in London last night, bringing an end to a 25-year wait for an English winner and further strengthening his legacy in the game.

Kane confirmed our football prediction by finishing ahead of Real Madrid’s Kylian Mbappe in second and Lamine Yamal of Barcelona in third. He also clinched the Gerd Muller Trophy as the season’s outstanding striker following a stunning campaign for both club and country.

Bayern’s talisman scored 73 goals and provided eight assists in 65 appearances for his club and the Three Lions. His 61 goals in 51 matches for the Bavarians is the highest single-season total by a player in the club’s history and the most for a club in one of Europe’s top five leagues since Cristiano Ronaldo for Real Madrid.

items.title: Premier League: Carrick On the Brink After Bournemouth Battering at Ol
items.excerpt: Manchester United suffered another crushing defeat in the Premier League on Sunday, losing 3-0 to Bournemouth at Old Trafford, which leaves them 16th in the league standi
body: Manchester United saw their winless run extended to eight matches on Sunday afternoon, when they were handed a 3-0 thumping by Bournemouth at Old Trafford on Matchday 8 in the Premier League.

The Red Devils are now 16th in the league standings, just one point above the drop zone. They are out of this season’s Carabao Cup and 20th in the Champions League with two losses and just one win after their first three matches in Europe.

Following Sunday’s loss, Carrick is now 1/5 to be the next manager sacked from the top flight according to the latest Premier League predictions . However, the fans who remained at Old Trafford after the loss made their feelings clear toward the head coach and his players.

Fans at the Stretford End were heard chanting Carrick’s name during his lap to thank those in attendance after the match, but those cheers turned to boos toward the players once the head coach entered the tunnel. Speaking to the media, Carrick said:

items.title: United States Grand Prix: How Antonelli Can Become the Youngest World
items.excerpt: The Circuit of the Americas has seen history made before, but the stakes in Austin have rarely felt greater than they do this weekend. With the 2026 United States Grand P
body: Andrea Kimi Antonelli is not just leading the pack ahead of the 2026 United States Grand Prix; he is on the verge of shattering a record many believed would stand for decades.

If everything falls into place beneath the Texas sun, the Italian sensation will etch his name into the history books, skipping the traditional years of midfield development to claim motorsport’s greatest prize - winning the 2026 F1 Drivers’ Championship title!
Just how extraordinary are the stakes this weekend? Let’s take a look at the record books!

As discussed in our F1 predictions , Sebastian Vettel holds the record as F1’s youngest World Champion, winning the 2010 title at 23 years and 134 days old. Max Verstappen secured his first at 24, and Antonelli, at just 19, can smash the current record by nearly four full years.

items.title: Curse Ended! Blockbuster Matchups Set As European Darts Championship 2
items.excerpt: The curse of the champion is broken, but the carnage is far from over! Day 3 of the 2026 European Darts Championship is set to enter what is shaping up to be a thrilling
body: After an opening round in which three of the world’s top five seeds suffered shocking exits, the 2026 European Darts Championship now moves into a gruelling best-of-19-legs second round this afternoon in Dortmund.

With the usual hierarchy already in tatters, Saturday promises another explosive day of action as the defending champion fights to retain his crown, a teenage sensation looks to make his mark on the big stage, and a fearless giant-killer targets another major scalp.

History was stacked firmly against the reigning champion Gian van Veen in R1, but the Dutch number one proved he is not ready to surrender his crown just yet, as he overcame one of the tournament’s biggest historical hurdles, defeating Andrew Gilding 6-4 to banish the dreaded “defending champion’s curse.”
However, he now faces a dangerous afternoon clash against one of the most confident players in the world right now: Luke Woodhouse!

items.title: This Weekend’s Best Player Props: Raphinha, Olise and Malen
items.excerpt: Another weekend, another list of some of the top player props to watch out for across Europe! This time around, we’re taking a look at El Clasico, Bayern’s trip to Freibu
body: Raphinha has come flying out of the gates in the 2026-27 La Liga season. He’s leading the scoring charts with 12 goals, three clear of Kylian Mbappe, and has 14 goals across all competitions in just 10 appearances.

He’s in some of the best form of his career at the moment, and the Blaugrana faithful will hope that it continues in the massive El Clasico clash against Real Madrid on Sunday. The underlying numbers suggest that it will continue:

Raphinha has been eased back from a right thigh injury picked up on international duty with Brazil. He returned for 20 minutes against Real Betis before being withdrawn on the hour in Wednesday’s 4-2 defeat at PSG, a planned substitution with this fixture in mind.
Before the injury, Raphinha had returned at least one goal in seven of his first eight matches of the campaign.

items.title: South Africa Smash Australia to Level Test Series Heading Into Cape To
items.excerpt: South Africa delivered a commanding performance to beat Australia by an innings and 31 runs at St. George’s Park on Thursday afternoon to level the three-match Test serie
body: After losing the first Test in Durban, South Africa bounced back to secure an emphatic victory by an innings and 31 runs at St. George’s Park on Thursday afternoon to level the three-match Test series at 1-1 and confirm our cricket predictions .

The Proteas were put in to bat by Australia after losing the toss on Day 1, and they rose to the challenge with Temba Bavuma leading the charge, scoring a stunning 179, including 18 fours and 1 six after Aiden Markram, Marques Ackerman, and David Bedingham were dismissed early.

South Africa’s middle order also failed to make much of an impact, with Matthew Breetzke, Ryan Rickleton and Wiaan Mulder scoring a combined 48, but Marco Jansen and Simon Harmer played huge roles late on, notching up 85 and 82 runs, respectively, to get the team to 425/9d.

Australia suffered a huge collapse in their first innings, bowled out for just 99 runs in 42.3 overs, with Jansen picking up 5/33, while the returning Kagiso Rabada claimed two scalps for 33 runs in 12 overs. Wiaan Mulder and Anrich Nortje shared the remaining wickets.

items.title: Besiktas vs Crystal Palace: Can the South London club turn its fortune
items.excerpt: Besiktas will welcome a struggling Crystal Palace to the Tupras Stadium on matchday three of the UEFA Europa League (League Phase). It is a battle of the Eagles as the Tu
body: The appointment of head coach Vincenzo Italiano this year has been the right choice by the board. The 48-year-old has mounted a title charge in the Turkish Super Lig, where Besiktas sit fifth with 15 points from eight games, leaving them four points behind the top spot. His overall record has been impressive as he boasts a 75% win ratio and is averaging 2.25 points per match.

Vincenzo Italiano has also guided Besiktas to two consecutive UEFA Europa League (League Phase) wins. This leaves the Black Eagles as one of ten teams that have maintained a 100% record in the competition. Their campaign began with Olympique de Marseille's visit to the Tupras Stadium. It was a walkthrough for them as they won 4-1 before edging Germany's Hoffenheim 3-2 away last week.
However, they enter this clash with their confidence dented after a 2-0 away defeat to Trabzonspor in the Turkish Super Lig. That was just the second time they failed to score in eight games.
Besiktas last won two straight games in the 2017-18 UEFA Champions League. Another victory here could see them improve on that record!

items.title: Bournemouth vs AC Milan: Cherries Favourites to Stun European Giants i
items.excerpt: Bournemouth host seven-time European champions AC Milan at the Vitality Stadium tonight. Riding a flawless start in the Europa League, the Premier League side enter tonig
body: Matchday 3 in the 2026-27 Europa League is on deck tonight with a jam-packed schedule, and one of the standout fixtures on the card comes from the Vitality Stadium, where newcomers Bournemouth will play host to European powerhouse AC Milan.
To appreciate the gravity of tonight’s clash from a Bournemouth perspective, you would have to look back to 2008, when the club did not just face relegation - they faced extinction!

Crushed by a financial crisis and forced into administration, the Cherries were relegated to the fourth tier of English football. To make matters worse, they were slapped with a devastating 17-point deduction before a ball was kicked in the 2008-09 League Two season.

Then came the turning point! On New Year’s Eve in 2008, Eddie Howe took the reins, and against all odds, he engineered the “Great Escape,” securing Football League survival on the final day of the season at Dean Court.

items.title: CAF Champions League: Sundowns, Pirates Brace for Crucial CAFCL Showdo
items.excerpt: Africa’s premier club competition, the CAF Champions League, reaches a crucial point this weekend, with 32 teams set to face off in the second leg of the second qualifyin
body: Mamelodi Sundowns face a stern test to keep their CAF Champions League title defence alive after kicking off this year’s qualifiers with a goalless draw against Angolan club Wiliete SC at Estadio Nacional de Tundavala in Lubango last week.

As discussed in our Sundowns vs Wiliete prediction , Masandawana received a bye in the opening preliminary round but struggled to create many clear openings in the first leg of this clash. The Brazilians now return to Loftus Versfeld in Pretoria this weekend with the tie hanging in the balance.
Miguel Cardoso’s preparations have been thrown off course for the decisive second-leg encounter!

Sundowns have a major injury concern ahead of the return leg, with Teboho Mokoena’s availability in serious doubt. The influential midfielder was carried off on a stretcher in the closing stages of the first leg in Angola after sustaining an ankle injury.

items.title: Bayern Munich vs Arsenal: Rampant Reds Set To Face UCL’s Most Miserly
items.excerpt: Two European giants. Two distinct footballing identities. One high-stakes Champions League showdown. Bayern Munich will take on Arsenal at the Allianz Arena tonight, Wedn
body: The Allianz Arena will be awash in red and white tonight when Bayern Munich host Arsenal in a highly anticipated UEFA Champions League MD3 clash that pits two of Europe’s leading sides’ contrasting footballing philosophies against each other.

This encounter will provide a stern examination of Vincent Kompany's new-look Bayern team, as their aggressive, free-flowing, and attack-minded approach is set to face a formidable obstacle in Arsenal’s seemingly impenetrable defence.

As discussed in our Champions League predictions for this match, Kompany faces a late selection crisis that has significantly affected his side’s engine room just hours before kick-off, with two of the team’s midfield stars ruled out and one listed as a major doubt.

The Gunners have a flawless record in the UCL this season, following up a 1-0 victory over Napoli with a 3-0 win against Lille last week. Die Roten smashed five unanswered goals past Bodo/Glimt in their opener but were held to a frustrating 3-3 draw by newcomers Viking on MD2.

items.title: Aston Villa vs Viking: Perfect home record meets visitors’ travel trou
items.excerpt: Aston Villa have made a perfect start to the UEFA Champions League (League Phase). They enter this clash aiming to maintain their 100% record when they welcome Norwegian
body: It hasn't been one of the best starts for Aston Villa in the Premier League this season. They have struggled to get the ball rolling and currently find themselves occupying 12th place in the table with eight points. This has them four points behind the European places.

Over the weekend, a positive result was recorded. A Johan Manzambi strike in the 36th minute saw the team secure a narrow 1-0 away win over Newcastle United. It was their second win in three games, meaning they have begun to find some consistency after a difficult opening to the campaign.

Despite their domestic setbacks, the Villans have shown reliability on the European stage. Last term, Unai Emery's charges conquered Europe by winning the UEFA Europa League . That accomplishment ended a 44-year wait for major European silverware.

Now, the Birmingham outfit are competing in Europe's top tier after a one-year absence. So far, it has been an impressive start to the current campaign, with back-to-back wins that see them rubbing shoulders with the elite in the top eight. Three points here could see them occupy the top spot.

items.title: Smriti Mandhana Begins India Captaincy Reign With T20I Series Sweep Ov
items.excerpt: Following Harmanpreet Kaur’s decision to step down as captain of India’s Women’s national cricket team, Smriti Mandhana enjoyed an excellent start to life as the new skip
body: The Indian Women’s national team confirmed our cricket predictions by securing an emphatic 3-0 sweep against Zimbabwe on home soil in Smriti Mandhana’s first T20I series as the new team captain.

Mandhana was handed the reins after Harmanpreet Kaur, India’s longest-serving captain among both men and women, stepped down from the role across all formats two weeks ago, bringing down the curtain on a successful stint, which included leading the team to their ICC Women’s World Cup title in 2025.

India took an unassailable 2-0 lead in New Raipur on Sunday, when they thrashed Zimbabwe by nine wickets and with 67 balls to spare. Perhaps fittingly, it was Mandhana who struck the winning runs, hoisting Olinder Chare out of the park to secure the series.

On Monday in the third T20I, Mandhana opted to bat first in order to give her side’s middle order an opportunity to spend time at the crease. The move paid off, with Kaur playing the starring role, reaching her half-century off just 25 balls before finishing on an unbeaten 91. Speaking after the match, Mandhana said:

items.title: Como vs Manchester United: Yoro Banned as Winless United Visit Fabrega
items.excerpt: Como host Manchester United at Stadio Giuseppe Sinigaglia on Wednesday in Champions League Matchday 3. Michael Carrick's side have not won in six matches across all compe
body: This is the first time the two clubs have met in competitive football. It is also Como's first match against English opposition in European competition.
In truth, Manchester United have a strong recent record against Italian sides, winning 10 of their last 16 European matches against Serie A clubs and losing just two.
Their European pedigree stretches back decades, though they have never faced an opponent with quite the same story as this season's Como.
Fabregas's side are making their Champions League debut this season after finishing fourth in Serie A last term, the highest league finish in the club's history.

items.title: Liverpool vs Villarreal: Frimpong and Szoboszlai Miss Out as Semi-Fina
items.excerpt: Liverpool host Villarreal at Anfield on Tuesday evening in Champions League Matchday 3. Andoni Iraola's side have won both of their European matches this season, includin
body: The clubs have met four times in European competition, all in semi-finals, and Liverpool have won three of those four matches. Their first European tie came in the 2015-16 Europa League semi-final.
Villarreal won the first leg 1-0 at El Madrigal through Adrian Lopez's 90th-minute goal, but Liverpool turned the tie around at Anfield in the second leg.
A Bruno own goal in the seventh minute set the tone before Daniel Sturridge and Adam Lallana completed a 3-0 win that sent Liverpool through 3-1 on aggregate.

The clubs met again in the 2021-22 Champions League semi-final. Liverpool won the first leg 2-0 at Anfield through a Pervis Estupinan own goal and a Sadio Mane finish, both scored within two second-half minutes.

items.title: NBA 2026-27 Opening Night: Season Tips Off With Cracking Triple-Header
items.excerpt: The wait is finally over! Tonight, the 2026-27 NBA season explodes into life with a historic, first-of-its-kind opening night triple-header. Fans are set to be treated to
body: The historic 2026-27 NBA opening night triple-header tips off under the afternoon lights at Little Caesars Arena, where a heavily reshaped Boston Celtics face a rising Detroit Pistons outfit ready to test its opponents' physicality in this Eastern Conference showdown.
All eyes in Boston will be on how the rotation adapts to the post-Jaylen Brown era!

Brown’s move to Philadelphia leaves Boston’s cornerstone, Jayson Tatum, carrying a heavier share of the offensive burden. He will have help from the explosive, newly acquired Paul George, while Mitchell Robinson is expected to anchor the team’s defence.

As discussed in our Detroit Pistons vs Boston Celtics prediction , aside from two-way player Devin Carter, who is ruled out with mononucleosis, the Celtics carry a clean bill of health into the regular season after a perfect 4-0 preseason campaign.
